class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleElectricInductionEngine
class.description: [RailVehicleElectricInductionEngine] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleElectricInductionEngine].

method.name: get_eimic_real
method.description: The traction an EIM controller actually asks for, -1-1 ([code]eimic_real[/code]).

members.member: [code]Engine:Vh1[/code] Velocity below which ED braking force starts to decay (minimum velocity of full braking force).
[code]Engine:Vh0[/code] Velocity at which ED braking force has fully decayed to zero.
[code]Engine:icif[/code] Ratio converting motor current to three-phase current.
[code]Engine:cim[/code] Ratio converting current to motor torque.
What the Mover's model of the electric engine's circuit is configured with.

How much the electrodynamic brake does per the brake cylinders' pressure; 0 lets the pneumatic brake switch it off ([code]abed[/code], [code]eimc[eimc_p_abed][/code], [code]Mover.cpp:5700-5719[/code]).
The FIZ [code]edep[/code] ([code]eimc[eimc_p_eped][/code]); 1.5, the original's default, when absent.
What the Mover's model of the engine is configured with beyond its facts, read by the drive.
The force asked for is held flat over the speed, not as a share of the full force ([code]Flat[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:5737[/code]).
[code]Engine:a1[/code] Traction force drop rate, in kN per km/h.
The coupling ([enum RailVehicleController.CouplingFlags]) a vehicle needs to control the inverters of another ([code]InvCtrCplFlag[/code]); 4, the control line, when absent.
[code]Engine:fcfu[/code] Inverter U/f setpoint.
[code]Engine:fcfuH[/code] Inverter U/f setpoint during ED braking.
[code]Engine:DU[/code] Voltage drop across the inverter.
The controller sets the force on a logarithmic scale ([code]eimclf[/code], [code]EIMCLogForce[/code]).

[code]Pmaxlist[/code] (undocumented on the wiki) Maximum power as a function of velocity; Each item's [member VehicleCurvePointItem.x] is velocity and [member VehicleCurvePointItem.y] is the maximum power at that velocity.
[code]Engine:dfmax[/code] Maximum motor slip.
[code]Engine:Uzmax[/code] Maximum supply voltage.
[code]Engine:Uzh[/code] Maximum supply voltage during ED braking.
[code]Engine:I0[/code] No-load (idle) current.
[code]Engine:cfu[/code] Nominal U/f ratio of the motor.
[code]Engine:dfic[/code] Ratio of motor current to the difference between field and motor speed.

The engine's table by position ([code]WWList[/code]); its speed and power fill the simulation's [code]DElist[/code], which the inverters' frequency is computed from ([code]Mover.cpp:5895-5908[/code]).
